PluginData.Tooltip: 1.0.1 — Learned ore search, scan estimates and deposit guidance. Overlay shutdown fix.
PluginData.Description: Zeo Ore Helper 1.0.1 helps locate ores with learned search data, configurable pings, optional SDX2 client scan estimates, and approximate nearby deposit guidance within 5 km. Includes the native Zeo settings menu and external HUD. Quantities are sampled estimates, not exact server totals. The search starts off each launch. Windows / Pulsar Legacy. The overlay now closes with its owning game or after its game window is destroyed, including crash recovery and plugin unload.
